verdict.rationale: Lever documents Talent Fit, which uses AI-powered matching and customizable criteria to surface high-potential candidates, so the core AI screening and matching exists. The pack has no documentation of how the matching works and no safeguards for automated decisions, such as bias controls, human review or explainability. Missing for 10: explanation of how the AI matching works, documented safeguards or human-in-the-loop controls for automated decisions, bias/fairness or compliance documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI helps screen and match candidates against the role — with the vendor documenting how it works and what safeguards apply to automated decisions

citations.quote: Lever's Talent Fit uses AI-powered matching and customizable criteria to surface high-potential candidates quickly and easily.
